NOTICE
Walk-in-interview for appointment of 05 Guest Faculty to teach B.Se. and M.Se.
classes for the Odd Semester (July to December, 2023) in Physics will be held
on Friday, 18th August, 2023 at 10.00 a.m. in the office of Chairperson,
Department of Physics as per following tentative schedule:
Days of Teaching Classes to be Subject to be Working hours
taught taught
Monday to Friday B.Sc./M. Se. Physics 9.00 a.m. to 5.00
p.m.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original documents and other
relevant documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the
details at the time of interview. The applicantion form for the post of Assistant
Professor is available at website (https:!/iobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php).
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
The above assignment will be on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs.
1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50000/- per month. The candidate
shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are
teaching in the Physics Department as a Guest Faculty. The candidates who are
already availing JRF scholarships in the University are not entitled for the
honorarium but they will be issued experience certificate for the Guest Faculty.
Minimum qualifications for the post is as per UGC norms.
